'''Salya Greeler''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Accountant/Legends|accountant]] and [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="AED" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:SlicerFemTemplate.jpg|250px|thumb|Possible depictions of Salya Greeler]]
[[File:SlicerMaleTemplate.jpg|250px|thumb|Randomly generated male depictions, deemed non-canon in Legends continuity]]
Salya Greeler was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="AED" />
